work.title: Targets and Tape
work.description: Layered fragments of technical diagrams, printed text, and crumpled metallic foil occupy a white ground, anchored by three compact discs and partial concentric-ring targets along the lower register. Grid-patterned paper, black architectural forms, torn newsprint, and a horizontal red strip near the upper edge compose the mixed-media surface.
work.composition: horizontal taped collage with disc base
